_comment: What each provider's own catalogue endpoint served to the campaign key, and the options it publishes per model.
A dated snapshot, not a registry: nothing reads it at run time. It is the list the provider comparison
(docs/reference/llm-providers-comparison.md, 'Models served and their default options') is written from, and the
baseline the next campaign diffs against to see what a vendor added, renamed or withdrew.
`orkeon llm models -p <provider> --json` returns the same identifiers; the fields beside them come from the raw
payload of the `source` request, renamed to one vocabulary (context, maxOutput, temperature, efforts, …) and
otherwise untouched. An empty object means the endpoint publishes the identifier and nothing else — the
measured options of those models are in catalog.json (requiredParams) and in the campaign reports.
Azure OpenAI and Ollama are absent: one serves an account's deployments, the other what a machine pulled.

anthropic.publishes: context, output cap, effort levels, thinking types, modalities

deepseek.publishes: context, output cap, modalities, effort levels and default

gemini.source: GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models (native listing; the OpenAI-compatible /models returns the same ids under models/…)
gemini.publishes: context, output cap, default temperature / topP / topK, maximum temperature, thinking

mistral.publishes: context, default temperature, capabilities, aliases, deprecation

grok.source: GET https://api.x.ai/v1/language-models (text models with their prices; /v1/models also lists the image and video ids)
grok.publishes: modalities, prices in $ per million tokens, long-context threshold, aliases

together.publishes: type, context, prices in $ per million tokens, whether a serverless endpoint is running

huggingface.publishes: modalities, and per routed provider: context, tools, structured output

openrouter.publishes: context, output cap of the top endpoint, default parameters, reasoning (mandatory, default effort, supported efforts), supported parameters, prices
